## Hypothesis

The top 5 parameter combinations currently ranked on the leaderboard (which share identical parameters) may capture positive edge_capture on J's winner days while avoiding excessive losses on loser days. Before promoting any wiring or trigger change based on these parameters, we must verify via walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) and realistic real-fills simulation that they achieve edge_capture > 771 (50% of max 1542) and wide_pnl without regressing on the 4/29 and 5/04 anchor wins.

## Mechanism

1. Extract the exact parameter set shared by the top 5 leaderboard entries (currently unknown; to be identified from leaderboard metadata).
2. Run walk-forward OOS validation using the established OP-16 anchor days as a held-out test window (or a separate OOS window per OP-22 protocol) to compute edge_capture, aggregate Sharpe, and final_score.
3. Run real-fills validation using cached OPRA data with realistic bid/ask, slippage, and fill simulation on the same parameter set, focusing on the 6 anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) and a broad OOS window.
4. Verify that edge_capture remains positive and wide_pnl is not driven by extreme concentration (top5_pct disclosure).
5. Confirm no regression on 4/29 and 5/04 wins (i.e., engine behavior yields at least breakeven or positive P&L on those days).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 guideline).
2. **Sample bias:** The top 5 parameter combinations are derived from leaderboard ranking which may be influenced by overfitting to in-sample data; sample size is opaque without Stage-1 backtest; overfit risk is high until OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill simulation not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loser if the parameter set fails to skip J's loser days; max drawdown could exceed historical maxima if the strategy takes on excessive risk; blow-up scenario involves catastrophic premium loss due to wrong-side entries during volatility spikes.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until validation; if top-5 days drive >100% of P&L, the edge is not robust.
